remarks: Excellent investment opportunity with this two-unit multifamily property offering strong income potential and value-add upside. The first-floor apartment features three spacious bedrooms and is ready for occupancy, while the second-floor two-bedroom unit presents an opportunity for the next owner to complete renovations and add value. Utilities are separately metered, allowing tenants to pay their own expenses and simplifying property management. The property is currently vacant, providing flexibility for owner-occupants, investors, or those looking to set their own rental rates. Professional management is familiar with the property and would be willing to remain in place for a seamless transition if desired. Conveniently located near local amenities, shopping, and transportation, this property offers an excellent opportunity to build equity and generate rental income. Can be packaged with 836 E 2nd, 840 E 2nd, and 414 Jefferson for a total of 12 units.
